setup.zh: 山门前排着长队。守山门的老执事一个一个看过去，看得人手心出汗。
setup.en: A long line waits before the gate. The old gatekeeper looks each child over, one by one, until palms sweat.

recap.zh: 山门前，瞿老的三试：腿、脑子、胆子。
recap.en: At the gate, Elder Qu's three trials: legs, wits and nerve.

text.zh: 沉鼎观收人，不看出身，只看三样：腿、脑子、胆子。
text.en: Chending Temple does not ask where you come from. It looks at three things: legs, wits and nerve.

text.zh: 一试，腿。三百级石阶，一炷香。香烧完之前上不来的，回家。
text.en: First, legs. Three hundred steps, one stick of incense. Not up before it burns out — go home.

exits.means: climbs the three hundred steps straight up

text.zh: 你一口气登了上去，腿抖得站不稳。香还剩大半截。
text.en: You climb it in one breath, legs shaking under you. More than half the incense is left.

label.en: First trial · Stop for breath on the way

exits.means: climbs the steps but rests on the way

text.zh: 你在第两百级坐下歇了口气。上到顶时，香只剩一指。
text.en: You sit on the two-hundredth step to catch your breath. At the top, a finger's width of incense is left.
